description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead operations at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Baltimore County, MD. This confidential role offers a unique opportunity to oversee all aspects of facility management, ensuring the highest standards of patient care, regulatory compliance, and operational efficiency. The ideal candidate will be a visionary leader committed to fostering a positive environment for both residents and staff.

As the LNHA, you will be responsible for the overall strategic direction and daily operations of the facility. This includes managing budgets, ensuring quality assurance, and leading a compassionate team of healthcare professionals. Your expertise will be crucial in maintaining our reputation for excellence and driving continuous improvement in resident outcomes and staff satisfaction.

This full-time position offers a competitive salary ranging from $115,000 to $145,000 per year, commensurate with experience and qualifications. Join a facility where your leadership makes a tangible difference in the lives of residents and the success of the organization.
requirements: Active and unencumbered Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in the state of Maryland.
Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, or a related field.
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience as an LNHA or in a similar leadership role within a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility.
Demonstrated knowledge of state and federal regulations governing long-term care facilities.
Strong leadership, financial management, and interpersonal communication skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $115,000 to $145,000 per year, based on experience.
